name: rex-agents
description: Rex terminal plugin for agents: mirrors each background command into its own Rex tab with live status, waits on Rex events, drives other agent sessions in Rex blocks, and loads the using-rex rules in Rex panes

interface.shortDescription: Skills for agents that work in the Rex terminal.
interface.longDescription: The using-rex skill says which commands get a Rex pane, how to launch and label blocks, and how to wait on Rex events. The drive-agent skill starts, briefs, and watches another agent session in a Rex block. Lua scripts wait on a block's reported status and list every block that needs a look.
defaultPrompt: Run the training job in a Rex pane and wait for it.
Drive a second agent session in Rex for this task.
